bio: Here, in the impressive Madrid outpost of sommelier and restaurateur Marcos Granda, the owner of the famous Skina restaurant in Marbella who has brought this different dining option to Madrid, the kitchen and the wine cellar take on equal prominence.This eatery, with its contemporary ambience, is the perfect setting in which to enjoy modern cuisine with a creative tint, based around the traditional flavours and the best ingredients from around Spain. Here, the gastronomic approach is epitomised by Clos Madrid’s mantra: great restaurants are those that make guests feel important. The name Clos is a French word for a high-quality wine estate surrounded by a wall....
